description: The imager of GeoEye-1 (GeoEye Imaging System, Maxar): relative spectral responses of the panchromatic and four multispectral bands, from Maxar's January 2023 constellation spectral response values.
short_description: GeoEye-1 imager (GIS) panchromatic and four multispectral bands
facility_description: Commercial very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellite operated by Maxar Technologies (formerly DigitalGlobe / GeoEye / Space Imaging).

links.label: Apollo Mapping technical documents (Maxar Constellation Spectral Response Values, January 2023)

notes: File RSR_GE1.txt in Maxar_Spectral_Response_2023.zip, distributed by the reseller Apollo Mapping (not hosted by Maxar). SVO's archived records cite the same page. No instrument paper reference verified. DetectorType energy assumed.

licence.scope: Owner Maxar Technologies. Blue, Green, Red, NIR and Pan are Maxar's 'Constellation Spectral Response Values (January 2023)' (RSR_GE1.txt in this zip, on the CDN of the reseller Apollo Mapping); no file in the zip carries a notice. The reseller page that links it (https://apollomapping.com/about-us/whitepapers) served a Cloudflare bot challenge and was not verified; Maxar's own terms were not checked. Green_svo and Pan_svo are SVO records recovered from Internet Archive captures (SVO states no licence).
